name: The Counterfactual Pivot
axiom: Show what would have happened without the work; that gap is the value.
trigger: Security, risk and compliance ROI cases, where prevention has no visible outcome to point at.

steps.text: State what actually happened, with its cost.
Describe the counterfactual at the same date.
Name the cost of the counterfactual recurring.

antiPattern.violation: Claiming averted incidents that no one can verify, which converts a strong argument into an unfalsifiable one.
antiPattern.remediation: Anchor the counterfactual to evidence: a peer incident, a near miss, a control that fired. Say what is estimated.
